note: All stories happened on 25 Nov 2026 or were first reported on 25 Nov 2026 (morning digests). Numbers and dates verified against the cited sources. HOW SURE: CONFIRMED=2+ outlets, OFFICIAL=the body itself, REPORTED=one outlet, CLAIM=one side, FORECAST=expected. Stories dated 23-24 Nov that only appeared in 25 Nov digests are flagged in date_check, not used as features.

stories.detail: Hormuz traffic fell over 40% in November; around 25 tankers reportedly hit by mines; 28 crossings in a recent 24 hours vs pre-war average 125-140 vessels a day; Brent about $88-89.
stories.headline: Hormuz tanker traffic collapses

stories.detail: Trump said in a New York Post Oval Office interview on 24 Nov that funding for military operations against Iran is secured until end of January, and toppling Iran's regime is 'probably doable' but not his goal.
stories.headline: Trump: Iran war funds secured to end of January

stories.detail: Iran said it will not hold talks with the US until its seven conditions are met, without naming them.
stories.headline: Iran will not talk to US until seven conditions met

stories.detail: Ukraine General Staff 25 Nov 08:00: 203 combat engagements on 24 Nov; Pokrovsk axis hottest with 28 Russian attacks repelled; 72 airstrikes, 211 guided bombs, 1,863 kamikaze drones, 1,520 shelling attacks.
stories.headline: 203 combat engagements in Ukraine in one day

stories.detail: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia on 24 Nov killed 2 and wounded 44 including 4 children.
stories.headline: Zaporizhzhia strike kills 2, wounds 44

stories.detail: Russian strike on Odesa killed 2 including a 17-year-old boy and injured 3.
stories.headline: Odesa strike kills 2 including a 17-year-old

stories.detail: Russia Duma passed the 2027-29 budget in third reading on 24 Nov; defence spending rises 27% to a record 17.1 trillion roubles, about a third of spending.
stories.headline: Russia defence budget rises 27% to 17.1tn roubles

stories.detail: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza on 24 Nov killed 7 including Hamas director of internal security Naim Abu Nahal, a 17-year-old and two policemen aged 23 and 33, despite the ceasefire in place since October 2025; more than 1,650 Palestinians killed since the truce per AFP tally.
stories.headline: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill 7

stories.detail: Hamas was to transfer bodies of four more hostages from 22:00 on 24 Nov; Israel closed the Rafah crossing and reduced aid in response to only four deceased hostages returned.
stories.headline: Hamas to return four hostage bodies; Israel shuts Rafah

stories.detail: Houthis threatened Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah is attacked; Saudi-led coalition ordered civilians to leave Hodeidah port; Saudi-led strikes hit Hodeidah.
stories.headline: Houthis threaten Jeddah as Hodeidah empties

stories.detail: Poland said a Russian surveillance drone briefly crossed its airspace on 24 Nov, days after three Russian Kh-101 missiles landed in Poland.
stories.headline: Russian drone briefly enters Polish airspace

stories.detail: Hungary PM Peter Magyar met Zelensky in Uzhhorod on 24 Nov, the first Hungarian PM visit to Ukraine since 2015.
stories.headline: Hungarian PM meets Zelensky in Uzhhorod

stories.detail: European Commission proposed a 22nd Russia sanctions package, targeting about 60 Russian banks, shadow-fleet tankers, crypto platforms, and bans on Russian athletes and flag at EU events.
stories.headline: EU proposes 22nd Russia sanctions package

stories.detail: European Commission proposal to lend Kyiv EUR45 billion ($49 billion) in 2027; EU leaders meet 26-27 Nov on Ukraine support.
stories.headline: EU to lend Kyiv EUR45bn in 2027

stories.detail: UK and Ukraine signed an agreement on production of attack drones, reported 25 Nov 09:12.
stories.headline: UK and Ukraine sign attack-drone production deal

stories.detail: Germany to spend over EUR4 billion on Patriot missiles.
stories.headline: Germany to spend over EUR4bn on Patriot missiles

stories.detail: Norway to give Ukraine at least $7 billion in 2027, air defence first.
stories.headline: Norway to give Ukraine at least $7bn in 2027

stories.detail: Shanghai Party chief Chen Jining, Politburo member, placed under investigation for 'suspected severe violations' of discipline and law, announced by Xinhua on 24 Nov. Age 62; former Tsinghua president, environment minister, Beijing mayor 2018-2022, Shanghai chief since 2022. Sources disagree whether he is the 4th Politburo member probed since 2022 or since 2025 - do not state a count.
stories.flag: NEAR-MISS: announced 24 Nov, not a 25 Nov event. DATE CHECK only.
stories.headline: Shanghai party chief Chen Jining under investigation

stories.detail: Huawei found guilty by a US jury on 24 Nov on 10 of 12 counts, including conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank/wire fraud and evading sanctions.
stories.headline: Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts

stories.detail: The Union government allotted a renovated bungalow in Lutyens' Delhi to the Dalai Lama's office, Gaden Phodrang, following a request from the Ministry of External Affairs.
stories.headline: Dalai Lama's office gets Delhi bungalow

stories.detail: Former Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina asked the Tarique Rahman government to arrange air transport for her return from Delhi to Dhaka on December 16; Dhaka insists on extradition.
stories.headline: Hasina seeks December 16 return to Dhaka

stories.detail: India called for human oversight in AI warfare at a UN Security Council debate on 25 Nov.
stories.headline: India calls for human oversight in AI warfare

stories.detail: Trump at the White House Thanksgiving turkey pardon ceremony on 24 Nov, turkeys named 'Freedom'; lamented the midterm election defeat, claimed the US would have been $6 trillion richer had Republicans won.
stories.headline: Trump pardons 'Freedom' at Thanksgiving ceremony

stories.detail: Trump said the US government could still take an equity stake in Nvidia, 'probably not too late', and would not rule out a pardon for Jensen Huang.
stories.headline: Trump: US may still take Nvidia equity stake

stories.detail: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO by the board on 23 Nov after Trump/Vance assured the board he posed no security risk.
stories.flag: Announced 23 Nov, widely reported 24-25 Nov. Brief only, dated in text.
stories.headline: Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO

stories.detail: Trump awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Rudy Giuliani on 24 Nov; also announced for Ben Carson, Connor Hellebuyck and Roger Clemens.
stories.headline: Medal of Freedom for Giuliani, Carson, Hellebuyck, Clemens

stories.detail: Trump considering new tariffs on India, China and 14 other economies as early as this week, per Wall Street Journal, following a USTR Section 301 investigation into subsidies and excess production in 16 economies.
stories.headline: Trump weighs tariffs on India, China and 14 more economies

stories.detail: CIA and ODNI suffered a cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, reported by NYT on 24 Nov.
stories.headline: CIA and ODNI hit by cyber breach

stories.detail: Kilmar Abrego Garcia voluntarily left the US for Spain on 24 Nov under a deal sparing forced deportation to Liberia; boarded a commercial flight to Madrid.
stories.headline: Abrego Garcia leaves US for Spain

stories.detail: European Court of Human Rights ruled on 24 Nov that states may turn back migrants at borders if they do not meet vulnerability criteria and are arriving from a state accused of weaponising migration; case from the 2021 Belarus border crisis with Poland, Latvia and Lithuania.
stories.headline: Top EU court backs migrant pushbacks

stories.detail: Magnitude 5.1 earthquake hit Antique, Philippines at 07:29 on 25 Nov; epicentre near Valderrama; Intensity V felt; PHIVOLCS says damage and aftershocks are expected.
stories.headline: M5.1 quake shakes Panay, Philippines

stories.detail: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake in the Balleny Islands region at 01:38 UTC on 25 Nov, depth 10 km; uninhabited area, no tsunami threat, USGS green alert.
stories.headline: M5.9 quake in Balleny Islands, no tsunami threat

stories.detail: Magnitude 4.7 earthquake 178 km ESE of Kimbe, Papua New Guinea at 04:30 UTC on 25 Nov, depth 10 km.
stories.headline: M4.7 quake near Kimbe, Papua New Guinea

stories.detail: Suspected gas explosion at a hot pot restaurant in Hanoi on the morning of 24 Nov killed 7 and injured 9.
stories.headline: Hanoi hot pot blast kills 7, injures 9

stories.detail: In Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, a bus carrying 41 passengers hit a broken-down truck on Al Watan Road; 13 people killed including Indian nationals; number not yet confirmed.
stories.headline: Bus crash in Ras Al Khaimah kills 13

stories.detail: Senegal navy rescued 974 migrants on five pirogues on 24 Nov; more than 5,200 rescued, intercepted or prevented since the beginning of November; more than 8,000 arrived in the Canary Islands in the first 12 days of November per UNHCR; around 175 migrants unaccounted for after contact lost with a boat from Dakar that departed about 9-10 Nov.
stories.headline: Senegal navy rescues 974 migrants

stories.detail: El Salvador President Nayib Bukele identified three Salvadoran soldiers killed in Haiti on 21 Nov: Lt. Cristian Daniel Palacios Santos and Cpls. Emerson Alexander Zepeda Zelada and Wilber Manuel Serrano Medina; about 2,500 Salvadoran troops deployed to Haiti.
stories.flag: Deaths 21 Nov, names released 25 Nov. Brief only.
stories.headline: Bukele names three Salvadoran soldiers killed in Haiti

stories.detail: Shenzhou-24 launched 25 Nov 08:18 Beijing Time from Jiuquan on Long March-2F, docked with Tiangong at 11:56 Beijing Time; crew Tang Hongbo (commander), Wu Yi, and Pakistani Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, first foreign national to visit China's Tiangong station, first joint Chinese-foreign flight; 90+ scientific experiments planned, four China-Pakistan cooperative projects.
stories.headline: First Pakistani reaches Tiangong station

stories.detail: Nvidia fell 5.9% on 24 Nov after surging 31.5% on 23 Nov, its biggest gain in more than two decades.
stories.headline: Nvidia falls 5.9% after 31.5% surge

stories.detail: US markets 24 Nov: Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70; S and P 500 fell 0.50% to 7,201.09; Nasdaq fell 1.48% to 23,733.54.
stories.headline: Dow tops 50,000 as Nasdaq slides

stories.detail: Asian markets plunged on 25 Nov: KOSPI down 5.3%, Taiwan down 5.1%, Nikkei down 2.9%, as the AI sell-off spread.
stories.headline: Asian stocks plunge as AI sell-off spreads

stories.detail: Bitcoin slid below $60,000 after a 20% November drop, over 50% down from its October 2025 peak above $126,000.
stories.flag: Single market-summary source (social post). Weak - not used on poster.
stories.headline: Bitcoin slides below $60,000

stories.detail: Anthropic fell below its $83 IPO price.
stories.headline: Anthropic falls below $83 IPO price

stories.detail: Peru cut its 2026 growth forecast to 3.1% from 3.4% citing El Nino.
stories.headline: Peru cuts 2026 growth forecast to 3.1%

stories.detail: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 15, India A vs UAE in Doha, Rising Stars Asia Cup: 204 off 53 balls, fastest List A double century in 52 balls, fastest List A hundred in 28 balls. Sixes count is inconsistent across sources (28 vs 22) - do NOT state a sixes number.
stories.headline: 15-year-old smashes 204 off 53 balls

stories.detail: Priyansh Arya: 181 off 68 balls with 19 sixes, highest T20 score by an Indian; Delhi 275/5 beat Tamil Nadu by 116 runs in Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, Indore.
stories.headline: Priyansh Arya hits 181, top T20 score by an Indian

stories.detail: World Chess Championship, Geneva: defending champion D. Gukesh drew Game 1 with Javokhir Sindarov, black pieces, 38 moves, 0.5-0.5; youngest title match in history, both aged 20.
stories.headline: Gukesh draws Game 1 of world title match

stories.detail: Court of Arbitration for Sport gave the Africa Cup of Nations title back to Senegal, overturning CAF's award of a 3-0 win to Morocco after Senegal walked off in the January final; Senegal won 1-0 after extra time, second title after 2022.
stories.headline: CAS gives AFCON title back to Senegal

stories.detail: East Bengal beat Al Hussein 1-0 in AFC Champions League Two, Kolkata, 87th-minute goal by Jeakson Singh, first ACL Two win.
stories.headline: East Bengal beat Al Hussein 1-0

stories.detail: FIFA confirmed a joint bid led by the USA, with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica, will host the 2031 Women's World Cup, first with 48 teams.
stories.headline: USA to host 2031 Women's World Cup
